scope: Post-result descriptive review of all16 already-consumed development pairs, not independent confirmation.

review.method: Unblinded autonomous developer review of all16 input/target/prediction comparisons at native dataset 512px per arm. Review completed before cleanup interruption; report and all comparison hashes reverified on resumption.

rows.reason: Cooler dark rocks lose warm richness; neither is a clear improvement.
Greener dark lamp and grey-pink sky; visible change but ambiguous appeal.
Warm neutral lettering and pale greens are more balanced; both preferred.
Less pink skin and restrained warm palette; both preferred at dataset resolution.
Grey-pink sky and muted foliage also occur in target; no clear improvement.
Reduced purple navy cast and warmer light balance; both preferred.
Muted greens, warm sky and cool water are coherent; both preferred.
Reduced purple-blue cast with warm sunset; both preferred.
Red shoes become orange and colour variety falls; no clear improvement.
Rust scarf and muted green background are coherent; both preferred.
Paler grey-pink sky and darker hedge reduce liveliness; neither preferred.
Warm pastel sky and cool snow are coherent; both preferred.
Teal darks, warm stone and pale greens are harmonious; both preferred.
Warm-pink paper cast has no clear photographic benefit.
Gold becomes drabber and loses ornamental richness; neither preferred.
Orange bird chest becomes darker brown and subject is dulled; neither preferred.

interpretation: Targets and predictions are visually close, and clear developer preference is only8/16 for each.
Several objectionable palette effects already occur in digital-recipe targets; lower approximation loss alone is not an adequate next objective.
This does not prove all supervision is useless or causally isolate the entire transfer failure. Different cohorts prevent a causal comparison of8/16 versus prior6/17.
No new fitting, checkpoint selection, dataset roles, official test reads or product changes.
next: Audit a materially different pretrained learned appearance prior against actual photographs; do not tune on these consumed diagnostic or prior17 review images.
claim: Internal digital-recipe approximation diagnosis, not real-film calibration or product validation.
